{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check which rows have missing revenue and their channel
missing_revenue = sales[sales['revenue'].isna()]
print('Channels with missing revenue:')
print(missing_revenue['channel'].value_counts())"}
